post.description:
Revokes the *current* session only (the existing, idempotent
`revoke_session`) and clears the cookie. Requires a valid session --
an unauthenticated or already-revoked credential gets the same 401
every other route returns, and learns nothing about other sessions.

get.description:
The minimum a frontend needs: the stable internal user id. No
token, hash, provider claim, or tenant list is exposed -- which
tenants this user may act in is answered per tenant by the existing
membership-checked `/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/...` routes.

post.description:
The header and the body are read here, after the attempt is counted,
so a request that passed the rate limits counts even when they are
malformed (owner decision S-1.2).

get.description: The person's unfinished signup, else their latest one. Read-only.

The kill switch's effective value, read-only. Production start-up
refuses `SIGNUP_ENABLED=true` (`crm_app.settings`), so it is false there.

The caller's workspaces (active memberships in workspaces that admit
their members), by name. Listing grants nothing.

The companies the list would show for these filters, in its order, as
CSV (UTF-8 with a byte-order mark, CRLF records). Nothing is stored.

413.description: More than 50,000 companies match: narrow the filters.

get.description:

post.description:
Read, validate and stage a CSV file of contacts or companies. Nothing
is imported until the import is committed.

Active members for everyone with `membership:read`; suspended ones
only for callers who may reactivate them; revoked ones never
(`crm_app.domains.membership`).

delete.description:
`move_to` names the stage that receives the removed stage's deals
(P4-B 8); without it, a stage holding deals is refused with
`stage_in_use` and the number of deals.
